verdict.rationale: E2B provides fully isolated, ephemeral cloud sandboxes (Firecracker microVMs) for running AI-generated code, with no connection to production systems — sandboxes are created fresh from templates, have their own filesystem/network, and can be killed or auto-expire, ensuring test isolation. Persistence/pause-resume and metrics further support safe iterative testing without touching real data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or case study contrasting sandbox vs production data separation, and independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs.
